---
title: "Forecast analysis"
---

```{r}
source("R/weather.R")
source("R/dashboard.R")
snapshot <- read_dashboard_snapshot()
hourly <- hourly_frame(snapshot$payload, snapshot$timezone)
daily <- dashboard_daily(snapshot)
hourly$score <- outdoor_score(hourly)
```

## Outdoor conditions

The score favours temperatures around 20°C, lower rain risk and lighter winds. It is an aid to planning, not a weather warning.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(head(hourly, 48), aes(time, score)) +
  geom_area(fill = "#22d3ee", alpha = .28) + geom_line(colour = "#67e8f9", linewidth = 1) +
  ylim(0, 100) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Outdoor score") + theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Seven-day outlook

```{r}
knitr::kable(transform(daily, sunrise = format(sunrise, "%H:%M"), sunset = format(sunset, "%H:%M")), digits = 1,
  col.names = c("Date", "Sunrise", "Sunset", "Low °C", "High °C", "Rain %", "Wind m/s", "Conditions"))
```

## Hourly weather heatmap

```{r}
#| results: asis
heat_long <- dashboard_heatmap_data(hourly, dashboard_now(snapshot), snapshot$timezone)
if (!nrow(heat_long)) {
  cat("No hourly forecast is available for today between 07:00 and 22:00 (Europe/Copenhagen).\n")
} else {
  print(ggplot(heat_long, aes(hour_label, variable, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "#0b1220", linewidth = .4) +
    facet_grid(variable ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#102a43", high = "#67e8f9", na.value = "#263449") +
    labs(x = "Local time", y = NULL, fill = "Value") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), strip.text.y = element_blank(), panel.spacing.y = grid::unit(.25, "lines")))
}
```
